title: In 1913, Ohio parents mailed their 10-pound baby to grandmother for 15 cents
summary_full: In a remarkable incident from 1913, an Ohio couple made headlines by sending their eight-month-old son to his grandmother using Parcel Post, a groundbreaking and controversial method. The minimal cost of just 15 cents shocked the public and sparked a series of similar reports across the nation. Safety concerns led the Post Office Department to swiftly ban the practice, highlighting the intricate nature of rural life during that era.
